lessons_used: Sign-in hints consistently drove winning tests, whereas hints on other steps showed no clear effect or hurt performance.
Desktop hotkey setup screens, guide screens, and quick-action redesigns on the finish step were helpful.
Interactive wait-stage info and waiting progress flows were helpful in multiple tests, though several wait-stage updates showed no clear effect.
Layout modifications and copy updates consistently showed no clear effect or hurt performance.
Most other new screens and new flows showed no clear effect or hurt performance, sometimes triggering early test stops.
Predictions overestimated gains for ineffective changes and underestimated gains for finish-step hotkey and quick-action improvements.
